verses.text: Yahweh told Moses: 📣
‘Tell Israel’s people to turn back and camp in front of Pi-Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, opposite Baal-Zephon. Camp beside the sea. 🏕️
‘Pharaoh will think, “They’re lost in the land. The wilderness has trapped them.” 🧭
‘I’ll make Pharaoh stubborn so he chases after you. Then I’ll show my glory over Pharaoh and his whole army, and Egypt will know I am Yahweh.’ The people did as they were told. ⚔️
When Egypt’s king heard the people had left, he and his officials changed their minds: ‘What have we done? We let Israel go from serving us!’ 😠
So Pharaoh got his chariot ready and took his army with him. 🐎
He took six hundred of his best chariots, all Egypt’s other chariots, and commanders over every one. 🛡️
Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn, and Egypt’s king chased Israel. Meanwhile, Israel’s people were leaving boldly. 🏃
The Egyptians chased them with Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, horsemen, and army. They caught up while Israel camped by the sea near Pi-Hahiroth, opposite Baal-Zephon. 🐎
When Pharaoh came close, Israel looked up and saw the Egyptians coming after them. They panicked and cried out to Yahweh. 😨
They said to Moses, ‘Were there no graves in Egypt? You brought us out here to die in the wilderness! Why did you do this to us? 😟
‘Didn’t we tell you back in Egypt, “Leave us alone; let us serve the Egyptians”? It would’ve been better to serve them than die out here!’ 😣
Moses told the people, ‘Don’t be afraid. Stand firm and watch Yahweh rescue you today. You’ll never see these Egyptians coming after you again. 🛡️
‘Yahweh will fight for you. Stay calm.’ 🕊️
Yahweh asked Moses, ‘Why are you crying out to me? Tell Israel’s people to move forward. 📣
‘Raise your staff and stretch your hand over the sea. Divide the water, and Israel’s people will walk through the sea on dry ground. 🌊
‘I’ll make the Egyptians stubborn too, and they’ll follow you into the sea. I’ll show my glory over Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen. ⚔️
‘When I show my glory over Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen, Egypt will know I am Yahweh.’ ✨
God’s angel, who had been leading Israel’s camp, moved behind them. The cloud column moved from the front and stood behind them too. ☁️
It came between Egypt’s camp and Israel’s camp. The cloud brought darkness on one side and light by night on the other. The two camps stayed apart all night. 🌙
Moses stretched his hand over the sea. Yahweh drove the water back with a strong east wind all night, turned the seabed into dry ground, and split the waters apart. 🌬️
Israel’s people walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground, with water like a wall on their right and left. 🌊
The Egyptians chased after them into the middle of the sea—all Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen. 🐎
During the morning watch, Yahweh looked down at the Egyptian army from the fire and cloud columns and threw their camp into confusion. 🌅
He jammed their chariot wheels so they struggled to drive. The Egyptians said, ‘Let’s get away from Israel! Yahweh is fighting for them against us!’ 🛞
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Stretch your hand over the sea. Let the water come back over the Egyptians, their chariots, and their horsemen.’ 📣
Moses stretched his hand over the sea. As morning came, the sea returned to its usual strength. The Egyptians tried to flee, but Yahweh swept them into the sea. 🌊
The water came back and covered the chariots, horsemen, and Pharaoh’s entire army that had followed Israel into the sea. Not one survived. ⚠️
But Israel’s people walked on dry ground through the middle of the sea, with water like a wall on their right and left. 🌊
That day Yahweh rescued Israel from the Egyptians. Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore. 🛡️
Israel saw the mighty work Yahweh had done against Egypt. The people revered Yahweh, trusted Yahweh, and trusted his servant Moses. 🙏
